symptom: Using Bash-style `&&` in Windows PowerShell 5.1 fails with InvalidEndOfLine parser error
prescription: Chain PowerShell commands with `; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE };` instead of `&&`

symptom: Unquoted `: ` inside YAML frontmatter description causes nested mapping parse failure
prescription: Wrap any SKILL.md description containing `: ` (e.g. Trigger on: ...) in double quotes or YAML block scalar `|`

symptom: Placing pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies inside package.json is ignored by pnpm v10+
prescription: Define `onlyBuiltDependencies: [esbuild]` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run `pnpm rebuild esbuild`

symptom: Deploying Cloudflare Workers with stale compatibility_date breaks Web Streams and Node compat APIs
prescription: Run `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run` first and pin `compatibility_date` to the current quarter in wrangler.toml

trigger_pattern: postgresql, postgres, supabase, migration, index, rls
symptom: Running plain `CREATE INDEX` on production tables locks writes and omitting RLS leaks cross-tenant rows
prescription: Use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` and verify `rowsecurity = true` on every public tenant table before shipping
